summary: Completed M109 and M110 artifacts are internally consistent and independently recounted. Source/GT/hash/archive/frozen-tensor checks pass. Both M110 fixed-state gates pass, but a beneficial reviewed-text increment remains unsupported. Two wording findings were corrected and verified. No implementation, data or artifact-integrity blocker was found.

gt_provenance.details: Dataset-box localization GT, model-weak unconfirmed text/pair supervision, and sequence-disjoint fit/development uses are explicitly separated. Reviewer directly checked 152 dataset arrays and all 3,502 event targets; 11 used weak pairs are in the fit split. No identity correctness certification follows from IoU agreement.

score_normalization.details: IoU is intersection/geometric union; summary means use state counts. M109 reports raw gradient norms plus standard vector cosines and weak/composite-baseline norm ratios, not rescaled tracking performance. All stored aggregates and vector identities checked within float tolerances; paired-batch means use nine equally weighted paired batches.

result_existence.details: M109 root/arm data, logs, three zero exits and source/input/final hashes agree. M110 four arm processes, six zero exits, 480 steps per final, 8,058 raw rows, all summaries/gates, 28 mirrored files and all 28 archive members agree. Historical training sources, results, finals, bank and labels are preserved; the one historical note hash change and two current wording revisions are documented and independently diff-checked.

active_math_and_exclusion.details: M109 actually calls autograd.grad on the three original losses over the 95,683 allowed coordinates, has no optimizer, and asserts state equality/None accumulated gradients. M110's sole optimization change is omitting weak from loss; the term is only detached for logging. Source diff and AST comparison verify all other trainer logic unchanged except status/provenance metadata. Direct CPU strict loads confirm 35 frozen parameter tensors and two buffers equal the parent for all four finals. GPU Empty outputs and gradient assertions remain recorded execution evidence, not reviewer forward replay.

scope.details: M109 is a fit-only initial/final gradient diagnostic, not historical AdamW update reconstruction or causal evidence for persistent conflict. M110 is one seed, two fixed-state finals, 130/22 Train sequences and 2,544/495 cached states. Both original gates pass, but own-condition mean IoU is 0.0003047300107551344 below preserved Empty. The repeatedly consulted Train development panel is not a fresh final test. No reviewed-text benefit, identity accuracy, seed robustness, recursive recovery or official benchmark gain is established. Two minor wording findings were fixed and verified without numerical/source changes.

evaluation_type.details: Mixed diagnostic: localization and candidate-IoU comparisons are real_gt on selected cached Train states; model-reviewed text/A-B supervision is synthetic_proxy; tensor/Empty/no-mutation checks are engineering invariants (self_supervised_proxy in this taxonomy). Gradient diagnostics are objective-analysis statistics rather than a benchmark accuracy score. No human_eval or simulation_only experiment is established.
